video.title: Deep Link, URL Scheme & Universal Link | Day 115
video.description:
Learn to explain how links open your iOS app: Deep Link, URL Scheme & Universal Link, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Deep Link - A link that opens a specific screen inside an app.
URL Scheme - A custom prefix, like `myapp://`, that opens your app from a link.
Universal Link - A normal web link that opens your app if it is installed, and the website if not.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Deep Link, URL Scheme & Universal Link in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
딥 링크, URL 스킴, 유니버설 링크 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Deep Link - A link that opens a specific screen inside an app.
한국어: 딥 링크: 앱 안의 특정 화면을 바로 여는 링크

URL Scheme - A custom prefix, like `myapp://`, that opens your app from a link.
한국어: URL 스킴: 링크로 앱을 여는 `myapp://` 같은 사용자 지정 접두어

Universal Link - A normal web link that opens your app if it is installed, and the website if not.
한국어: 유니버설 링크: 앱이 있으면 앱을, 없으면 웹사이트를 여는 일반 웹 링크

landscape.hook: Can you explain Deep Link, URL Scheme and Universal Link in English?

dialogue.title: A link to one note

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, marketing wants a Deep Link to a single note.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. We can use a URL Scheme like `myapp`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The `open` function checks the `host` and shows the note.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is there a problem with a URL Scheme?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Anyone can claim the same scheme, and it fails if the app is missing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: A Universal Link. It is a normal web link.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So it opens the app when installed, and the website if not?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Use a Universal Link for emails and ads.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And keep the URL Scheme for testing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Both give us a Deep Link to the note.
This Deep Link opens the settings screen.
